source_name: DataHub German Bundesliga dataset sourced from football-data.co.uk
source_category: public downloadable football results and odds dataset
terms_of_use_status: DataHub identifies ODC-PDDL-1.0, but upstream odds provenance and applicable bookmaker data rights require review
licensing_or_redistribution_status: Mirror license is stated; upstream and bookmaker redistribution scope is not sufficiently established for this project
storage_permission: Not approved pending clarification of upstream odds rights
market_coverage: 1X2, totals, and Asian handicap where available
timestamp_precision: Match dates and optional times; no quote capture timestamp

operator_note: Fails closed because capture timestamps are absent and upstream odds-use terms require clarification.
